About Uncut Electro-Mechanical Engineering

Founded in August 2016, Uncut Electro-Mechanical Engineering (Pty) Ltd delivers top-tier engineering, condition monitoring, repair, and maintenance services to public and private sectors across the African continent. We combine technical excellence with a deep commitment to Broad-Based Black Economic Empowerment (B-BBEE) and local skill transfer.

Executive Leadership & Technical Expertise

Miss Siphokazi Ngubo

Founder & Managing Director

Siphokazi founded Uncut Electro-Mechanical Engineering in August 2016 on the principles of empowerment and technical excellence. Holding a degree in Strategic Logistics Management and a diploma in Business Management, she brings extensive strategic leadership experience from both the public and private sectors to drive operational growth.

Sikhosiphi Shezi

Technical Operations Lead

Joined in June 2026, bringing multi-disciplinary master technical certifications across electrical and mechanical domains, with experience spanning both public and private industrial sectors.

Qualifications & Certifications:

  • Trade Test in Electromechanical Engineering
  • Diploma in Operations Management
  • Competency Certificate in ORHVS
  • Competency Asset Reliability Practitioner (ARP)
  • Mobius Vibration Analysis Certification
  • Infrared Thermography Certification
  • Electrical Motor Diagnostics Certification
  • Oil & Failure Analysis Certifications
  • Shaft Alignment Certification

B-BBEE & Transformation Commitment

Through our BEE policy, we are dedicated to empowering historically disadvantaged South Africans with vital engineering knowledge and technical skills to secure the means of production for future generations.

Technical Mentorship

Nurturing black professionals into core technical management roles within motor rewinding, switchgear, and asset reliability.

Youth Development

Providing specialized technical training for young black female and male South Africans to foster sustainable industry capabilities.

Skills Funding

Direct internal funding for in-house skills development and continuous human capital enrichment.

Quality Assurance & Technical Rigor

ISO 9001:2015 Alignment

We operate in strict alignment with ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System requirements. Our processes ensure consistent delivery of products and services that comply with statutory requirements while constantly measuring customer satisfaction and continuous process improvement.

Workmanship & Guarantees

  • 12-Month Warranty: All workmanship carries a full 12-month warranty from date of installation (subject to OEM operational compliance).
  • Honest Pricing Policy: If machine repair costs exceed 70% of a new machine's value, we transparently advise replacement over uneconomical repair.
  • Rapid Response: 1–3 hour callout response times and 1–5 day turnaround for emergency breakdown works.
Field Operations

On-site insulation resistance testing and diagnostic condition monitoring performed on heavy asset transformers.

Skills Transfer & Community Impact

On-Site Client Training

To address the national technical skills shortage, we provide hands-on practical skills transfer to our clients' internal teams during site interventions.

  • Generator controller programming
  • Machinery lubrication & oil/coolant management
  • Gland packing adjustment & replacement
  • Battery maintenance & machine alignment

Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR)

Our CSR program actively identifies, utilizes, and rewards local talent. We offer young South Africans opportunities to gain practical, technical experience on live infrastructure projects—giving our communities real tools and hope for a brighter technical future.

Providing precision electro-mechanical engineering, 24/7 emergency breakdown support, and heavy industrial maintenance solutions to plants, mines, and utilities across South Africa.
